channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: India’s Archers Targeting Olympic Glory: The Rise, Roots, and Impact of Technology
item.description: Archery holds a revered place in Indian history.

item.title: Wuhan Jiangda defeats East Bengal 2-0 to stay perfect in AFC Women’s Champions League
item.description: Defending champions Wuhan Jiangda secured a controlled 2-0 win over East Bengal, led by a first-half double from Wang Shuang.

item.title: AFC unveils WAVEMAKER as first dedicated match ball for Women’s Asian Cup 2026
item.description: The AFC has revealed WAVEMAKER, a new match ball inspired by Australia’s coastal landscapes for the Women’s Asian Cup 2026.

item.title: Diksha Dagar clinches golf gold as India adds multiple medals at Deaflympics 2025
item.description: Diksha Dagar defended her Deaflympics title, while shooter Mahit Sandhu secured silver with a record-breaking qualification score.

item.title: India’s women boxers sweep four golds as hosts dominate World Boxing Cup Finals 2025
item.description: Minakshi, Preeti, Arundhati Choudhary and Nupur struck gold on a standout day for India, supported by four silver medals in the men’s events.

item.title: India crush Germany 63-22 to top Pool A at Women’s Kabaddi World Cup 2025
item.description: The defending champions completed a flawless group stage with a dominant win over Germany, securing a semifinal berth.

item.title: AFC Women
item.description: East Bengal FC Women have earned $170,000 from their AWCL debut, with total prize money potentially rising above $1.3 million depending on their future results.

item.title: Anahat Singh and Joshna Chinappa advance to semifinals at the Indian Open Squash
item.description: Top seed Anahat Singh and experienced campaigner Joshna Chinappa recorded straight-games wins to enter the women’s semifinals in Indore.

item.title: Australian Open 2025: Lakshya Sen progresses to semis; Satwik-Chirag exit
item.description: Lakshya got the better of his younger compatriot Ayush Shetty in straight games.

item.title: AFC U17 Asian Cup Qualifiers: Bibiano Fernandes names 23-member squad
item.description: India will face Palestine, Chinese Taipei, Lebanon and Iran in Ahmedabad from November 22 to 30.
